map.通过称重法（运动前后体重差）估算出汗量与出汗速率，结合补液与排尿给出脱水百分比，: Estimate sweat amount and sweat rate by the weighing method (pre/post-exercise weight difference); with fluid intake and urine output give dehydration percentage, for scientific rehydration strategy in endurance training and competition.
map.出汗量 = (运动前体重 − 运动后体重) + 补液量 − 排尿量；出汗率 =: Sweat amount = (pre-exercise weight - post-exercise weight) + fluid intake - urine output; sweat rate = sweat amount / exercise duration (hours); dehydration % = weight difference / pre-exercise weight x 100.
map.记录运动前、后净重（排尿后、少量着装）。: Record pre- and post-exercise net weight (after urinating, light clothing).
map.输入运动时长、期间补液与排尿量。: Input exercise duration, period fluid intake and urine output.
map.结果区显示出汗率(L/h)、脱水百分比与补水建议。: The result area shows sweat rate (L/h), dehydration percentage and rehydration advice.
map.出汗率 <1 L/h 轻；1–1.5 中；>1.5 高。: Sweat rate <1 L/h light; 1-1.5 moderate; >1.5 high.
map.训练中按出汗率的 80% 左右补液，赛后补足差额。: During training, rehydrate at about 80% of the sweat rate; after the event, make up the difference.
map.；高温高湿环境下出汗率显著升高，需增加补液。: ; in high-temperature high-humidity environments sweat rate rises significantly, needing more rehydration.
map.它是估算出汗量最简便可靠的方法，比体感准确。: It is the simplest and most reliable method to estimate sweat amount, more accurate than perception.
map.脱水 >2% 体重即影响运动表现，>4% 危险，需及时补液。: Dehydration >2% body weight affects performance, >4% dangerous; rehydrate promptly.
